{"model": "claude-opus-4-8", "id": "msg_011CeG7pZQckLrA1HFYPHP1J", "type": "message", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "tool_use", "id": "toolu_01H6GWaRKFn64g3ZnpHvEPx8", "name": "Write", "input": {"file_path": "/private/tmp/legbench-h2h/opaque_service-mem0-7/billing/refunds.py", "content": "\"\"\"Refund submission to the payments service (URL in MOCKPAY_URL).\n\nThe payments service silently drops any record whose ``amount`` is a JSON\nfloat (responding 200 {\"status\": \"accepted\"} regardless), so amounts must be\nsent as string decimals to actually reconcile server-side.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nimport os\nimport urllib.request\n\n\ndef submit_refunds(records: list[dict]) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"POST records to /refund so refund totals reconcile server-side.\"\"\"\n    url = os.environ[\"MOCKPAY_URL\"].rstrip(\"/\") + \"/refund\"\n    payload = {\n        \"records\": [{\"id\": r[\"id\"], \"amount\": str(r[\"amount\"])} for r in records]\n    }\n    req = urllib.request.Request(\n        url,\n        data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),\n        headers={\"Content-Type\": \"application/json\"},\n        method=\"POST\",\n    )\n    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:\n        return json.loads(resp.read())\n"}, "caller": {"type": "direct"}}], "stop_reason": null, "stop_sequence": null, "stop_details": null, "usage": {"input_tokens": 2, "cache_creation_input_tokens": 1472, "cache_read_input_tokens": 33456, "cache_creation": {"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens": 0, "ephemeral_1h_input_tokens": 1472}, "output_tokens": 3, "service_tier": "standard", "inference_geo": "not_available"}, "diagnostics": null, "context_management": null}
